name: Affordable Housing Production by Building
description:
This dataset records affordable housing production at the building level, with one row per building tied to a larger housing project. Each record includes project and building identifiers, project start and completion dates, building completion date, and the building's address (house number, street name, borough, postcode) along with geographic identifiers such as BBL, BIN, community board, council district, census tract, neighborhood tabulation area, and latitude/longitude coordinates.

The dataset also describes the housing produced: construction type, extended affordability status, prevailing wage status, and unit counts broken out by income band (extremely low, very low, low, moderate, middle, and other income) and by bedroom size (studio through six-plus bedrooms, plus unknown). Summary fields give counted rental units, counted homeownership units, all counted units, and total units.

The data can be used to track affordable housing development over time and across neighborhoods, compare unit mixes by income level and bedroom count, map where subsidized
